en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a European village nestled in a valley with hills in the background. The main features are a prominent castle-like structure on a hill (with towers and multiple wings) and a large church with a tall spire in the foreground. The rest of the village consists of small houses with sloped roofs. The text at the top reads 'Liebstadt i. Sa. — Schloß Kuckuckstein'.
